scope: Embedding only, same non-lazy 3.8 production SDK. Excludes full App/HMR and does not compare actual 9000/9001.

method.cache: One persistent browser profile; same origin and SDK URLs; one prime per arm, ordinary reloads; no interception or cache disabling
method.order: Alternating forward/reverse pairs; previous SDK disposed before next arm
method.endpoints: Top navigation -> visible SDK SVG + actual workspace ready + common clear enabled; then first real empty SMILES. Also report owner-document/import/mount intervals.
method.functional: CCO import, real oxygen mouse drag verified by KET coordinates, SMILES export, clear, one Worker, retirement to zero Workers

provenance.scope: Same frozen non-lazy production SDK bytes, two document embeddings. No App/HMR timing claim.

smoke.cause: Harness disposed the session before its clear+settle button operation finished. Fixed only the measurement fixture; retained the original AbortError.

formal.use: Sensitivity group only: outer iframe diagnostic script added a blocking request. Primary formal-control removes that extra probe request.

limitations: Same production SDK in a minimal shell; not a full-App or actual9000/9001 comparison.
No independent throughput calibration: CDP configured 50Mbps; owner fetch probe validates latency and frame coverage.
10 samples per arm: nearest-rank P95 is observed maximum, not a stable tail guarantee.
Only warm empty reload performance. Real CCO operations validated after the timing endpoints.
Import interval includes loading/parse/evaluation; not all attributed to CPU.
SDK source artifacts match r3 and copied production files match each other; reused prior bundle is not claimed to be a new reproducible build.

During documentation cleanup, finalVerification.preexistingWorkingFilesUnchangedAfterCommit was changed from the unexplained numeric value 1000 to null (unknown). No source record was found to verify that historical claim; samples, statistics and evidence hashes are unchanged.
Evidence paths identify local historical artifacts and SDK installations; these files are not distributed with the repository.

statistics.quantiles: Nearest rank: sorted(values)[ceil(n*p)-1], including P50 and P95. For n=10 P95 is maximum.
